name: sync-dev-deployment
description: Sync application dev environment deployment scripts

scripts.docker:build:fallback: npm run build:local && cp Dockerfile.fallback Dockerfile && npm run docker:build && cp Dockerfile.fallback.bak Dockerfile
scripts.docker:restart:dev: npm run docker:down:dev && npm run docker:up:dev
scripts.docker:restart:prod: npm run docker:down:prod && npm run docker:up:prod
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run docker:down:dev && npm run docker:build:dev && npm run docker:up:dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run docker:down:prod && npm run docker:build:prod && npm run docker:up:prod
scripts.docker:deploy:fallback: npm run docker:down && npm run docker:build:fallback && npm run docker:up
scripts.docker:redeploy:dev: echo 'Starting dev redeploy...' && npm run docker:stop:dev && npm run docker:build:dev && npm run docker:up:dev && echo 'Dev redeploy completed!'
scripts.docker:redeploy:prod: echo 'Starting prod redeploy...' && npm run docker:stop:prod && npm run docker:build:prod && npm run docker:up:prod && echo 'Prod redeploy completed!'
scripts.docker:clean:all: npm run docker:clean:dev && npm run docker:clean:prod && docker system prune -f
scripts.health:check: curl -f http://localhost:8061/actuator/health || echo 'Application not ready yet'
scripts.db:init:dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose-dev.yml exec sync-test-mysql mysql -u root -p123456 sync_test < /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql
scripts.db:init:prod: docker-compose -f docker-compose-prod.yml exec sync-prod-mysql mysql -u root -p sync_prod < /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01-schema.sql
scripts.help: echo 'Available commands: deploy (dev), deploy:dev, deploy:prod, docker:down, docker:down:dev, docker:down:prod, docker:stop, docker:redeploy, docker:logs, docker:status, docker:clean, health:check'

author: Development Team
